title: Tampa Electric Outage
description: A power outage event in the Tampa Electric service territory.

outageId.description: Unique identifier for the outage event.

cause.description: Reported or assessed cause of the outage.

customersAffected.description: Number of customers currently affected by the outage.

affectedArea.description: Geographic description of the outage area.

outageStartTime.description: When the outage was first reported or detected.

estimatedRestorationTime.description: Estimated time of power restoration. Null if unknown.

actualRestorationTime.description: Actual restoration time. Null if still active.

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the most recent status update.
